scope: 24 individual symbol briefs plus the previously approved Munagasah folio; every final logo also receives a separately rendered exact-name wordmark.

items.brief: Preserve the established smoked-indigo glass document leaves with titanium edges and coral inspection marker.
Preserve the user-approved ivory travertine gateway, burgundy glass door and thin antique-gold threshold. Remove only the white backdrop for this isolated symbol; the launcher icon stays white.
Preserve the established interlocking pale-mint economic-zone volumes with the turquoise connector and deep-blue foundation.
Preserve the established pale-aqua ceramic civic-path ribbon and coastal-teal translucent endpoint.

Three pine-green satin ribbons interweave into a clear branching workforce-path symbol, with one terracotta connector and light-jade edge. Organic organizational geometry, not a corporate bar chart or generic people silhouettes.

An elegant dark-plum architectural corner balanced on two pale-lavender stone planes, with one muted-rose precision seam. Strong rectangular property silhouette, legal-editorial restraint. No arches, gavel, shield or justice scales.

A single refined copper bridge link spanning two malachite geometric anchors, with a cream inset that creates a clear connection. Strategic commercial confidence, sculptural but simple. No envelope, handshake or generic chain links.

An expressive magenta and blush folded-paper composition opening into three lilac editorial petals with asymmetric rhythm. Rich creative-studio identity, tactile paper, sophisticated color blocking. No text-like glyphs, document stack, chat bubble or generic flower.

Two precisely interlocking ocean-blue ceramic service loops with a mint inner path and pale-yellow joint. Rounded, welcoming, fluid but highly readable. No speech bubbles, headset, robot or infinity-symbol cliche.

Two miniature industrial-white and electric-blue cargo blocks held in a vivid-orange L-shaped shipment route. Bold ribbed container surfaces, precise logistics geometry, restrained industrial lighting. No globe, flag, ship, letters or tiny labels.

A refined charcoal evaluation frame around three warm-stone qualification tabs, aligned by one acid-lime precision cursor. Analytical and transparent, clear large shapes. No resume lettering, person silhouette, checkmark, magnifier or bar chart.

A small open ultramarine architectural courtyard made of softly stepped porcelain planes with one orchid central welcome space. Warm, human, spatial onboarding. No arch, doorway, chair, people or generic house silhouette.

A warm peach pebble gently supported by an organic soft-violet continuous cradle with a warm-white inner edge. Comforting tactile matte resin, balanced asymmetry, very clear silhouette. No heart, medical symbol, robot or chat bubble.

A night-blue glazed solar disk with a candlelight inner arc and a carefully interrupted muted-gold orbital rim. Contemplative astronomical identity, a simple memorable silhouette. No moon-and-star religious emblem, cloud, clock numbers or borrowed weather icon.

Two parallel evergreen precision beams supporting a single sage stone orb in a poised balanced composition, with chalk inner faces. Restrained financial editorial sculpture. No money, coins, religious seal, scales of justice or upward arrow.

A tactile shallow terracotta plate with a Mediterranean-blue rim, holding one beautifully formed vanilla-colored culinary curl and a small green herb accent. Sensory premium food identity with simplified forms. No cutlery, lettering, certification stamp, menu or restaurant scene.

A warm ivory house cross-section with a precise aubergine roof and three nested peach-cream interior rooms, one dusty-rose room accent. Domestic ceramic architectural object, intimate and clear. No financial chart, coin, gateway or generic flat house pictogram.

A small parchment folded-map sculpture with slate-blue cartographic planes and one vivid-apricot route crossing a fold. Exploratory editorial identity, readable folded silhouette. No actual country outline, invented geographic labels, flag, passport or location pin.

A forest-green sculptural energy channel branching into three pale-citron flow tips around one lime reservoir. Organic measurable flow geometry, frosted recycled resin. No generic leaf, bulb, recycling arrows, electricity bolt or globe.

One softly inflated eucalyptus translucent membrane forming a calm open oval with two delicate mist-colored breathing folds and a muted-sage inner rim. Quiet atmospheric glass, very restrained highlights. No path ribbon, infinity knot, heart, lungs or medical readings.

A single angular burnt-orange material loop with a recycled-paper cream laminated edge and one dark-petrol cut surface. Tactile fibers and clear circular-economy silhouette. No standard three-arrow recycling symbol, globe, leaf or trash bin.

A refined bronze archival frame holding one sandstone pottery fragment with a sparse incised geometric line. Museum-quality tactile material, rich but restrained, clear at small sizes. An original conceptual heritage symbol, not a real attributed artifact. No text, national emblem or copied museum object.

A bold royal-blue open-ended ramp-like navigation form with a warm-white passage and one sunflower tactile raised point. High legibility, restrained dimensional depth, empowering simplicity. No wheelchair symbol, person silhouette, medical sign or tiny details.

Two distinctive harvest-red produce forms sharing one golden stem-path, one warm-cream cut face showing a few large sculpted seeds. Action-oriented food redistribution identity, tactile and generous. No plate, heart, handshake, grocery basket, lettering or certification badge.
